verdict.rationale: Navan's documented public API covers retrieving and updating card transactions, expenses, custom fields, and users. Its MCP only lets you view card status and details. No evidence shows creating a card with a limit, locking a card, or updating card controls through the API. Transaction-level updates and read-only card visibility are adjacent features, not card issuance or management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API
